notes: Single source of truth for FUCINA (RTX factory) model profiles. Consumed by host/factory/server.py, host/scripts/fetch_model.sh, install/rtx_factory_docker.sh and install/fucina.sh. weights_gb is the approximate VRAM for the weights alone; KV cache is added by the fit estimator from LIMEN_LLAMA_CTX.

profiles.title: Qwen3-4B (Q4)
profiles.notes: Fits a 6 GB laptop GPU (e.g. RTX 4050) at context 4096–8192.

profiles.title: Qwen3-8B (Q4)
profiles.notes: Most robust for study and extraction on a 12–16 GB card.

profiles.title: Qwen3-8B + EAGLE-3 draft
profiles.notes: Faster decode when VRAM allows; falls back to plain if the draft is missing.

profiles.title: Qwen2.5-14B Instruct (Q4)
profiles.notes: Heavier teacher; tight on a 12 GB laptop GPU.

profiles.title: Qwen3.6-27B MTP (Q4)
profiles.notes: Needs a 16 GB card. Disabled on smaller GPUs. Requires the HF CLI fetcher.
